Class MenuEditorController

java.lang.Object
app.controller.manager.MenuEditorController
public class MenuEditorController extends Object
Coordinates the manager interface for viewing and editing menu drinks.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Configures table value and display factories, then starts loading items.

    • refreshMenu

      private void refreshMenu()
      Loads the menu items on a daemon worker thread and updates the table.

      Duplicate refreshes are ignored while another load or write is in progress. A load failure is shown in an error alert.

    • addDrink

      private void addDrink()
      Opens and validates the drink form, then asynchronously inserts the selected item and its recipe.

      Form/database failures are reported in an alert; database write failures occur in the background task and are also shown to the user.

    • showMessage

      private void showMessage(javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType type, String title, String message)
      Displays a modal alert with the supplied type, title, and message.
      Parameters:
      type - alert type controlling its icon and buttons
      title - title shown in the alert window
      message - content shown in the alert

    • editSelected

      private void editSelected()
      Opens the selected drink in the edit form and asynchronously saves validated changes.

      If no row is selected, a warning is shown. Form-loading and database write errors are presented to the user.

    • removeSelected

      private void removeSelected()
      Confirms removal of the selected drink, then asynchronously deletes it and its recipe.

      If no row is selected, a warning is shown. Cancellation leaves the database unchanged, and deletion errors are presented in an alert.
